thread:
leah.pm: Quick sync reminder  vendor choreography meeting TOMORROW 9am PT. Need to finalize wave sequencing for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi/B200 and confirm embargo windows + fallback rules.

mike-partners: Two quick asks: (1) can we lock whether vendors treat microcode as separate embargoable material, and (2) any regional supply flags (APAC customs delays) that push MI300 later?

sam-infra: Infra conservative targets: H100 Dedicated pool early-mid June; H200 optimistic late July; MI300 NA late June but APAC may be +10 days. Gaudi revB patch is still ETA mid-May from partner engineering.

press_ops: Historically NVIDIA asked for ~10 days; AMD ~7. We'll collect exact numbers but plan for staggered waves if any vendor requests >9 days. If embargo >14 days, loop legal.

si_jordan: SI preference for onboarding order: 1) H100/H200 (driver-mature), 2) MI300 (quant pipelines), 3) Gaudi+B200 (cost lanes). Need canary images, driver bundles, and a signed changelog to schedule SI runbooks.

vendor_bot: Preflight form: https://forms.redwood.example/hw-onramp-choreo (fields: eta_signoff, embargo_days, microcode_embargo_boolean, region_limits). Auto-remind in 12h.

leah.pm: Proposal: three waves spaced ~2-3 weeks: Wave 1 = H100 (invite-only canaries + early Dedicated), Wave 2 = MI300 + H200 (wider Hosted + Dedicated), Wave 3 = Gaudi + B200 (economy lane). Wave assignment conditional on vendor sign-off + no critical embargo conflicts.

mike-partners: Add explicit fallback rule: if a vendor misses wave X, auto-route to compatible family and label UI as "compat: family-name". Also publish an SLO matrix per SKU so customers know perf/cost tradeoffs.

sam-infra: Canary telemetry: allocate 30d retention for canary cohort; infra will make temporary buckets and attach a cost estimate. Recommend a small golden canary (100 instances) to validate KV-cache and batching.

si_jordan: Please ask vendors for prebuilt quant artifacts or export scripts (int8/4bit). That reduces SI onboarding time significantly. Add cloud-image diffs (AWS/Azure/GCP) to the form.

press_ops: Runbook item for "late-driver-breaks": hold announcement, trigger vendor triage call, enable regional UI fallbacks, notify customers. Owner: partner-ops + press.

leah.pm: Action items before sync: vendors fill form, infra publish canary plan + cost, SI upload checklist, press collect embargo days per vendor. If you can't make 9am PT DM me for a 1:1. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
